name: I&W Rhythm
reference: The rhythm tone of Images and Words (Dream Theater, 1992, BearTracks Studios, prod. David Prater): Pull Me Under, Take the Time
rig: Six-string in standard E (Pull Me Under per Line 6's tour template), Petrucci's first Ibanez 'Picasso'. A Mesa Quad Preamp in the studio and two TriAxis live into a Simul-Class 2:90 (Thomann); a 4x12 with Vintage 30s and a DBX 166 compressor in Line 6's tour template. Forum posts also name a Mark IIC+ or Mark IV. EQ settings, cab and mics on the record aren't documented
notes: Double-tracked rhythm, panned hard left/right (inferred: bright, slightly fizzy, gently scooped). Left: Mesa TriAxis Lead 2 Yellow with a Mesa 5-band graphic EQ, Marshall 1982B 4x12, SM57/R121 (a full-rig capture: the documented live preamp). Right: Mark IIC+ 'Tight Rhythm' into a Mesa 4x12 V30 SM57 with a gentle V (+2 dB 100 Hz, -3 dB 650 Hz, +2 dB 8 kHz). Align wobble 0.25 between the sides, like two takes. SW8 BOOST = TS9 clean push (not on the record); SW9 DELAY = 420 ms. Small room at the house level. The owner's low B string isn't on this record. Levelled offline with rigsim --exact to -14 LUFS.

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
Mesa TriAxis Lead 2 Yellow, 5-band GEQ, Marshall 1982B 4x12, SM57/R121 (full rig)
